prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized sprite study. Produce ONE production-quality original character sprite sheet with true transparent background, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows of 8 isolated full-body sprites, equally spaced cells, no labels. Character is ARIA from input1 (canonical identity, costume and hair) and input2 (existing small-character body silhouette). Input3 supplies ONLY warm painted palette / softly colored outline style. New look: warm storybook 2D RPG character, crisp readable color shapes and softly colored dark brown contours, 2-3 shading tones, no glossy hair stripes, no speckled texture, no chunky black pixel fringe. Elevated three-quarter view slightly looking down on head and shoulders, all face screen-right 3/4, recognizable face. About 3.3 heads tall, mature young-adventurer silhouette rather than baby proportions; all poses must share IDENTICAL head size, torso length, limb lengths and camera. Canonical details: shoulder/collarbone-length low-volume pale blonde hair with ONE pale lavender lock on the side opposite white-flower hair clip, pointed elf ears, green eyes, tiny subtle back half-up braid only (not a thick headband braid); plain forest-green cape back, gold botanical trim only along front edges, white blouse and layered skirt, brown leather waist and gloves, knee-height brown boots, single diagonal chest strap, cheerful curious approachable expression. No dangling metal ornament. No weapon or bag in these study sprites, hands free. Row1: 0 relaxed standing two feet planted; 1 walking left foot forward/right back contact; 2 walking passing, left planted below hip and right foot raised crossing; 3 walking right foot forward/left back contact. Row2: 4 walking passing right planted below hip left foot raised crossing; 5 standing holding a small invisible box at waist with two palms supporting (no drawn object); 6 seated on an invisible chair with knees bent and boot soles grounded (no chair); 7 crouching to inspect an invisible ground object, hands reaching gently (no object). Walk genuinely alternates legs and opposing arms, no sliding duplicate poses. Every cell equal physical scale; seated and crouched silhouettes must be shorter than standing, never scaled up to fill cell. Same head width exactly throughout. Full visible hair and boot tips with generous transparent margin, align ground-contact feet to same baseline within each cell. No floor, no shadow, no glow, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image, no UI or text. 1536x1024 landscape canvas.
